briefdescription.para: Returns the smaller of two values.

detaileddescription.para: XStrm_TxInitialize initializes the XStrm_TxFifoStreamer object referenced by InstancePtr.

Specifies the FIFO keyhole size in bytes.
FIFO driver instance this streamer uses to transfer data into the actual FIFO.

briefdescription.para: Returns the next receive frame length in bytes.

detaileddescription.para: XStrm_RxGetLen notifies the hardware that the program is ready to receive the next frame from the receive channel of the FIFO, specified by InstancePtr.
Note that the program must first call XStrm_RxGetLen before pulling data out of the receive channel of the FIFO with XStrm_Read.

parameterdescription.para: References the FIFO on which to operate.

simplesect.para: XStrm_RxGetLen returns the number of bytes available in the next frame.

briefdescription.para: Reads bytes from the receive streamer.

detaileddescription.para: XStrm_Read reads Bytes bytes from the FIFO specified by InstancePtr to the block of memory, referenced by BufPtr.
Care must be taken to ensure that the number of bytes read with one or more calls to XStrm_Read() does not exceed the number of bytes available given from the last call to XStrm_RxGetLen().

parameterdescription.para: References the FIFO on which to operate.
Specifies the memory address to place the data read.
Specifies the number of bytes to read.

briefdescription.para: Flushes the streamer and starts a transmit.

detaileddescription.para: XStrm_TxSetLen flushes to the FIFO, specified by InstancePtr, any bytes remaining in internal buffers and begins a hardware transfer of data out of the transmit channel of the FIFO. Bytes specifies the number of bytes in the frame to transmit.

parameterdescription.para: References the FIFO Streamer on which to operate.
Specifies the frame length in bytes.

briefdescription.para: Writes bytes to the transmit streamer.

detaileddescription.para: XStrm_Write writes Bytes bytes of the block of memory, referenced by BufPtr, to the transmit channel of the FIFO referenced by InstancePtr.
Care must be taken to ensure that the number of bytes written with one or more calls to XStrm_Write() matches the number of bytes given in the next call to XStrm_TxSetLen().

parameterdescription.para: References the FIFO on which to operate.
Specifies the memory address of data to write.
Specifies the number of bytes to write.

detaileddescription.para: See xstreamer.h for a description on how to use this driver.
